---
title: "Dissipative-Conservative System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y+xy+xz\\
\dot{y} &=& 1-x^2+yz\\
\dot{z} &=& x+ax^2-y^2
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-0.61$ and initial condition $(0,-1,0)$.
